Source:  https://game-icons.net

Icons (white foreground, transparent background):
  fire        by sbed
  drop        by lorc
  air-zigzag  by lorc
  rock        by lorc
  wizard-staff by lorc
  rune-stone  by lorc
  cauldron    by lorc

The original SVG files are kept in this folder for provenance. The PNGs used
by the game live in assets/art/icons/ and are tinted at runtime.
